option_relations.rationale: Option A describes acute pancreatitis with pancreatic pseudocyst and pancreatic-pleural fistula, which are all components of the more comprehensive diagnosis in the leaf.
Pancreatic ascites is a specific manifestation and complication of the broader diagnosis described in the leaf.

Complete pancreatic divisum with pancreatic-pleural fistula describes two components of the overall diagnosis in the leaf, where pancreatic divisum is a likely underlying anomaly and pancreatic-pleural fistula is a complication.
Pancreaticopleural fistula is a specific complication of the broader diagnosis described in the leaf.
